name: HDMI to USB 2.0 Video Capture Card
shortDescription: HDMI to USB 2.0 Full HD 1080p Video Capture Card (Supports 4K Input Resolution / Full HD 1080p Output Recording / Real-Time Live Streaming / Compatible with DSLR, Camcorder, Action Cam, Consoles / Compact Metal Design /
descriptionHtml:
HDMI to USB 2.0 Full HD 1080p Video Capture Card (Supports 4K Input Resolution / Full HD 1080p Output Recording / Real-Time Live Streaming / Compatible with DSLR, Camcorder, Action Cam, Consoles / Compact Metal Design / Plug & Play)

Stream and record high-definition video directly to your PC or Laptop with the HDMI to USB 2.0 1080p Video Capture Card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Perfect for live streaming, gaming broadcasts, video conferencing, and teaching, this portable capture card easily connects your DSLR, camcorder, or gaming console via HDMI and outputs smooth Full HD 1080p video over USB 2.0 without requiring external drivers or additional power adapters.
